steps.name: inventory-oci-resources-and-state-boundary
steps.summary: Verified OCI API authentication and the connected shared Compute, 47 GiB boot volume, reserved IP and network resources. No block attachments or existing state; shared resources remain references under ADR-016. Inventory, provider candidates and recovery boundaries are recorded in inventory.md.

steps.name: codify-existing-oci-infrastructure
steps.summary: Codified eight inventoried shared OCI resources in the isolated infra/terraform/oci-shared root, with boot volume/private IP references, disk preservation, pinned Terraform 1.16.4/OCI 9.3.0, Windows/Linux lockfile, private inputs/import mapping, Git exclusions and credential-free CI. Inventory/schema, fmt/backend-disabled init/validate, JSON/YAML/links and privacy checks passed. No backend connection, import, live plan/apply or production changes.

steps.name: adopt-existing-resources-with-no-change-plan
steps.summary: Prepared the isolated private/versioned bucket bootstrap, backend examples, credential-free CI for both roots, and adoption/drift/state-recovery runbook. A private saved bootstrap plan has exactly one bucket create and no updates/deletes; fmt/init/validate passed. Existing operator is an administrator, so no redundant IAM grants are proposed. Approval-required: apply the reviewed bucket plan, confirm current DB backup/isolated restore evidence (separate approval if newly needed), then approve remote backend connection and eight imports. No cloud apply/import or post-import no-change plan has run.
